changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm
CREATE INDEX recipes_library_cursor_idx ON recipes (user_id, updated_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE library_state = 'SAVED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX recipes_title_trgm_idx ON recipes USING gin (LOWER(title) gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE INDEX recipe_ingredients_name_trgm_idx ON recipe_ingredients USING gin (LOWER(name) gin_trgm_ops)
